title: Signed waiver approvals (.a2dlc/approvals.json, versioned, outside the tree_hash)
description:
Each approval is an SSH signature (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace a2dlc-approval) over the text "a2dlc-approval/1
<target>
<waiver_sha256>
<file_blob>
". file_blob is the git blob of the target file in the candidate: if the file changes, the approval stops being valid. The allowed keys live outside the repo (A2DLC_ALLOWED_SIGNERS or ~/.config/a2dlc/allowed_signers).
